instructions: Every open-source release from 1.9.5 through 1.31.8 is vulnerable, according to NGINX's security advisories .

A distribution package can carry a fix without changing the version number that nginx -v reports, so compare the full package version with the distribution's own advisory.
CIRCL's response guidance lists turning off HTTP/2 as a temporary mitigation until you can upgrade.

But it feels like that's what's happening when a disclosure notice refers to "an incident being at a third party", as though somehow that makes it better.
